whatsNew.en:
- Telegram Gold V12.9.2 update 🟨
- Request verification for your account or channel
- Unlock Premium features
- Ghost mode to hide read receipts 👻
- Hide online status
- Hide typing status
- Prevent message deletion 💯
- Show edited messages 🌟
- Translate chats to your language 🅰
- Organized menus
- Stop annoying ads via Telegram Gold options > Special Features > Stop Sponsored Messages ⚡️
- Other bug fixes and improvements
